mechanism: Magnesium may reduce pyrazinamide absorption through chelation and increased GI pH, potentially decreasing antimicrobial efficacy; pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricemia leading to magnesium depletion through renal losses.
action: Separate administration by 2-4 hours and monitor serum magnesium levels and uric acid during concurrent therapy; ensure adequate magnesium intake if depletion occurs.
